title: Kasethan Kadavulada
desc: Ramu, a young man, ropes his acquaintances into an intricate plan to steal money from his evil stepmother.

title: Natpe Thunai
desc: Prabhakaran, a former hockey player, helps a local team save their ground by training them to win a match against the Pondicherry team. However, a corrupt politician has his eyes set on the ground.

title: Doctor
desc: When a military doctor tracks down his former fiancée's kidnapped niece, he discovers a complex human trafficking ring in Goa. He then weaves an intricate trap to capture the perpetrators.

title: Sanga Thamizhan
desc: Murugan, a happy-go-lucky young man, falls in love with the daughter of Sanjay, an industrialist. However, trouble arises when Sanjay notices that Murugan looks like a figure from his dark past.

title: Unakkum Enakkum
desc: Kavitha, a village belle, and Santhosh, the son of a business tycoon, fall in love with each other. Later, Kavitha's brother challenges Santhosh to prove his prowess in farming.
